homepage.body:
By selecting Continue, you acknowledge that you are leaving the ACOG site and going to the ACOG Foundation site.

American College of Obstetricians & Gynecologists

Registration is Open for the 2027 ACSM

Join the ACOG community in Los Angeles as we spotlight the people, innovations, and bold ideas that will shape the future of the ob-gyn field.

Learn More and Register

Now Trending

Clinical Guidance ACOG’s library of trusted evidence-based guidance, designed to support ob-gyn decision making.
Coding Resources Everything you need to navigate the transition to the new obstetric billing codes taking effect January 1, 2027.
Combating Misinformation Discover resources to help you identify and address misinformation.

News and Insights

Leading the Conversation in Ob-Gyn Health

Press Release

ACOG Statement on U.S. Loss of Measles Elimination Status

The loss of the United States’ measles elimination status represents a significant public health setback, indicative of the resurgence of highly preventable contagious diseases in the country.

Press Release

ACOG Releases New Guidance on the Use of GLP-1s in Pregnancy and Lactation

Press Release

ACOG Statement on 2027 Final Physician Fee Schedule

Press Release

ACOG Expands Recommendations for Management of Menopause Symptoms

Press Release

ACOG Strengthens Recommendations Supporting Salpingectomy for Ovarian Cancer Prevention

Now Available For Preorder

Coming January 2027: Your Pregnancy and Childbirth: Month to Month, Eighth Edition. Bulk orders are available for members.

Preorder Now

Events and Education

Opportunities for Learning and Connection

Los Angeles, CA May 21–23, 2027
2027 ACOG Annual Clinical & Scientific Meeting
Learn More
Denver, Colorado February 24–27, 2027
2027 CREOG & APGO Annual Meeting
Learn More
Washington, D.C. March 7–9, 2027
Congressional Leadership Conference
Learn More
Every Stage Health

Every Stage Health is your patients’ go-to resource for reliable obstetric and gynecologic health information.

Explore Patient Site
ACOG Foundation

The ACOG Foundation champions programs that improve the lives of all people seeking ob-gyn care, their families, and their communities.

Learn About the Foundation

Join ACOG—and help shape the future of ob-gyn health

ACOG membership equips you to lead with confidence and clarity in a rapidly changing health care environment. Be part of a purpose-driven, patient-focused community shaping the future of obstetrics and gynecology.

Join Now
